text:
Carla M: Quick sync on Llama-C & Mosaic-7B onboarding — need final owners, license ok, perf profiles, and PR status. TL;DR: blocked by Llama-C license (CC-BY-NC?) and Mosaic bench shows tail latency spikes. Owners/status pls? cc @nidhi @dmitri

Ben S: I'm owner for Llama-C (artifact + quant). Confirmed upstream repo has LICENSE: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Here's the link: https://github.com/llama-c/model/blob/main/LICENSE — we can't use that for Hosted/Dedicated without a relicense.

Nidhi (Legal): Confirmed. CC-BY-NC forbids commercial use -> not acceptable for Hosted/Dedicated. Options: (1) request relicensing, (2) restrict to Private deployments only, or (3) find an alternative model. Filing internal request IR-4923 and pinging upstream. I'll escalate if we don't hear back in 72h.

Dmitri P: Mosaic-7B bench snapshot: p50 ~45ms, p95 ~120ms, p99 ~220ms on A100-80 with q4f16 batching=8. Observed spikes when seq_len > 1024 due to fallback kernels. Pushed perf profile + perftrace: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-profiles/pull/221

```yaml
model:
  name: mosaic-7b
  quant: q4f16
  batch: 8
  seq_len_bucket: [128,512,1024,2048]
```

Alice R: Catalog checklist reminder: we need license_tag, owner, model_card, perf_profile link, recommended quant, and a documented fallback variant. I'm going to hold Mosaic and Llama-C from the public launch until legal signs off on Llama-C. For Mosaic, add a note about the seq_len caveat in the model_card.

Ben S: Follow-up: I can draft a relicense request and offer attribution + dataset acknowledgements as upstream asked. Will open PR/issue and link here (ETA ~3 business days).

Carla M: Action items recap: Ben -> pursue relicense for Llama-C (ETA 3d). Nidhi -> confirm IR-4923 & escalation (ETA 2d). Dmitri -> add fallback perf numbers + canary config (ETA 2d). Alice -> prepare launch preflight doc & checklist (ETA EOW). Ops -> reserve 2xA100 staging slots next week for end-to-end canary.

deploy-bot: staging slots reserved: mosaic-7b-canary -> 2xA100-80 on 2026-03-24 (slot-id: stg-7782).

Ben S: ack :thumbsup:

Nidhi (Legal): ack — will update this thread and tag infra-security if we need KMS/HSM scoping.
